desc:
👍 LIKE GOAL: 3500 likes = Like Legend title for everyone! 👍

🏰 BIG UPDATE: SEASON 1 + UPGRADES! 🏰
⏳ PLAY SOLO: 33 levels with NO TIMER. Tap it at the top!
💰 UPGRADES: Bigger Budget, up to +50% money per bridge!
⚔️ SEASON 1: CASTLE QUEST! 30 tiers of rewards until 7 Dec.
🏆 Top 100 on a leaderboard? Get your own #1 to #100 title!
🎁 Gift skins to anyone in your server.

Build a bridge. Watch the trucks roll. Be the last bridge standing!

🔨 Build from wood, steel, cable and road in 75 seconds.
🚚 Heavier and heavier toy trucks drive over every bridge at once.
💥 Weak beams snap and trucks splash into the river.
👑 The last bridge standing wins coins and XP.
🌋 Candy Canyon, Frosty Peaks and Volcano Valley.
🛸 Chaos: a UFO, a dinosaur and a disco bus hit every bridge!
🥧 Bridge broke? Throw pies at the trucks still driving!
🔥 Daily Streak, daily quests and Chaos Hour every weekend.
👻 No waiting: every round starts right away.

Up to 8 builders per server. A new twist every round.

badges.name: Welcome, Builder!
badges.desc: You joined Last Bridge Standing! Build a bridge, then watch the toy trucks try to cross it.

badges.name: Splash!
badges.desc: Your bridge broke and your ride took a swim. Every great builder's first bridge falls!

badges.name: Built to Last
badges.desc: Your bridge held through every wave of a test, all the way to the finale.

badges.name: Last Bridge Standing
badges.desc: You won a round! Yours was the last bridge standing.

badges.name: Unstoppable
badges.desc: You won 3 rounds in a row. Nobody can stop your bridges!

badges.name: Piggy Saver
badges.desc: Your bridge held every wave and cost no more than the piggy. Smart builders save big!

badges.name: Shiny Silver
badges.desc: You reached level 5 and your level star turned shiny silver!

badges.name: Solid Gold
badges.desc: You reached level 10 and your level star turned solid gold!

badges.name: Star Collector
badges.desc: You collected 15 stars by holding bridges on lots of different gaps!

badges.name: Met the Developer
badges.desc: You played in the same server as the developer of Last Bridge Standing!

badges.name: Chaos Survivor
badges.desc: Your bridge held through a chaos finale! Monster trucks, whales, tanks and trains could not knock it down.

badges.name: Candy Captain
badges.desc: You cleared all 10 Candy Canyon campaign levels. Sweet bridges!

badges.name: Frost Ranger
badges.desc: You cleared all 10 Frosty Peaks campaign levels. Not even a snowstorm stops you!

badges.name: Lava Legend
badges.desc: You cleared all 10 Volcano Valley campaign levels. Your bridges laugh at lava!
